method: Fifty genuinely distinct registered source areas were checked at exact-model level, then each atomic field received its own acceptance or rejection application. Public XHS was limited to search-engine indexes under shared-runtime coordination; no new XHS capture, login, CAPTCHA, security-verification action or bypass was attempted.
identity_note: The retained listing is the discontinued Venta Disc, not the current Venta R. Exact archived catalogs, specialist retailers and independent reviews establish the old platform, but the CNY 6,888 listing does not identify year, trim, condition or seller authority.
